role: SDR / Appointment Setter, Positive Reply Follow-Up

hero.label: Made for SDR
hero.headline: I want to be the SDR who turns your best replies into booked meetings.
hero.subheadline: Appointment setting at the positive-reply stage is where deals actually live or die, and I've been obsessed with that exact moment since my first cold outreach sequence. At Copygen.ai I learned that getting a reply is just the beginning, and converting warm interest into a calendar invite is its own skill set worth mastering. I want to bring that urgency and follow-through to your team at a stage where every booked meeting genuinely moves the needle.

whyCompany.title: Positive-reply follow-up is an underrated, high-leverage SDR specialty
whyCompany.body: Most SDR roles lump prospecting and follow-up together, but isolating the positive-reply stage means every conversation you touch is already warm. That focus creates a compounding advantage: faster cycle times, higher show rates, and cleaner data on what actually converts. It is a smart structural bet for an early-stage team that needs pipeline velocity now.

whyCompany.title: Joining early means building the playbook, not inheriting one
whyCompany.body: At this stage the reply-handling process is still being written, which means whoever steps in now gets to shape how the team qualifies, sequences, and books. That kind of ownership is rare for someone two years into their career. I thrive in environments where there is no manual yet and figuring it out is part of the job.

whyCompany.title: My Copygen.ai reps and NextAfter sequences map directly to this role
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold outreach from scratch inside HubSpot and LinkedIn, helping land 15 to 20 paying clients by managing every touchpoint from first send to signed deal. At NextAfter I worked inside B2B digital campaigns where message timing and response handling were treated as conversion levers, not afterthoughts. Positive-reply follow-up is exactly the slice of the funnel where those two experiences overlap.

quote: I have spent the last year learning that a positive reply with no follow-up is just a missed meeting. I want to be the person on your team who makes sure that never happens.
